name: data-table-reorder
title: Data table reorder
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A dense table that slides rows into place when a column sort changes, with sparkline, meter, and trend slots.

meta.descriptionEs: Orden por columna con filas que se deslizan a su sitio, y celdas para chispa, avance y tendencia.

examples.title: Piezas del taller
examples.description: Horas, avance y tendencia. Datos inventados.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: Vacío, carga, error, token largo y cuarenta filas.

meta.usage:
<DataTableReorder
  rows={rows}
  columns={columns}
  sort={sort}
  onSortChange={setSort}
  detail={(row) => ({ title: row.name, description: row.note })}
/>

api.name: rows / columns
api.description: Rows need an id. A column cell is a slot. sortValue enables sorting. TMeta is never read.

api.name: sort / onSortChange
api.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. The live region announces the new order.

api.name: detail / onRowSelect
api.description: detail opens tooltip-card on the named column. onRowSelect fires from that cell.

api.name: DataTableSparkline / Meter / Trend
api.description: Mini drawings for a cell. Trend keeps a text label so color is not the only signal.

api.name: loading / error / disabled
api.description: Loading and error are visible states. disabled blocks sort and row actions.

api.name: labels
api.description: Spanish is the default. dataTableReorderLabelsEn is the English set.

docs: Clean-room dense table. Column sort is a callback plus optional controlled sort. Rows keep their identity and move with a layout animation; reduced motion snaps. Empty values sort last. The detail column can open tooltip-card. Sparkline, meter, and trend are slots, not a second table. The component does not write rows and never reads meta. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite button, empty, skeleton, or tooltip-card. The item ships no theme. No mockup source, copy, colors, or assets were copied.
